message: Tests use trivial assertions (isinstance, >= 0) and do not verify the actual streak values or behavior.
suggestion:
def test_current_streak():
    today = date(2026, 7, 22)
    dates = [date(2026, 7, 22), date(2026, 7, 21)]
    assert current_streak(dates, today=today) == 2
    assert current_streak([], today=today) == 0

message: Streak computation starts from `today - 1`, ignoring activity completed today and returning an incorrect streak.
